run_create_uma_finetune_dataset: run the CLI script to create a UMA finetune dataset from ASE atoms directories with energy or force regression tasks
create_yaml_finetune_config: create YAML configuration files for UMA model finetuning with dataset paths, force RMS, and linear reference coefficients
launch_processing_ase_atoms: launch parallel processing to convert ASE atoms object directories into a format ready for finetuning
compute_normalizer_and_linear_reference: compute the force RMS normalizer and linear reference coefficients from processed training data
review_create_yaml_function: review the create_yaml function that generates data task and finetune template YAML configs for UMA models
